Built against [wamsoft/krkrz_dev](https://github.com/wamsoft/krkrz_dev) V2.6.5

- **Face windows**: the speaker's face shows beside the text, cut from their sprite as it looks now, and crossfades to the next speaker's (`faceCrop` in `envinit.tjs`; Config turns it off)
- **Staging for writers**: characters that make room for each other (`[pip join]`, `[ai leave]`, `[env makeroom]`), keeping a scene and coming back to it (`[env keep]`, `[env restore]`, for flashbacks), and in the sample twenty gestures, screen shakes, close-ups, an eyecatch card and a veil for inner thoughts, a word each
- **Reduce Motion**: a Config switch that stops effects, looping movies, the TV static, Live2D and 3D layers, showing a still picture where a layer names one (`still=`)
- **Moving through the story**: back to the start of the scene or the last choice, a rewind a message at a time, on to the next scene, and an offer to skip text already read; the backlog shows faces, a picture of the scene at a line, and jumps by scene
- **A CG viewer** with zoom, pan and pinch, stepping through a CG's variations
- **Sound**: `loudness.csv` evens out levels per kind of sound and per file; `uisounds.csv` gives every button, page turn, slider, prompt, choice and menu its sound (the sample's screens have sounds now); credits timed to two places in the song (`rollfrom=`, `rollto=`: times in ms, or labels, though music with labels can hang the engine now and then: `UPSTREAM.md` 44)
- **Config**: the volumes play a sample as you set them, each character has a volume and a Test button, and Undo and Revert take changes back
- **Fixed**: movies play on the web (the opening never showed there: `UPSTREAM.md` 41); the book and multiripple transitions run all the way and keep each picture's transparency, drawn by kagex itself now (extNagano's stopped short or brought the old picture back: `UPSTREAM.md` 42)
- **AlphaMovie** (`.amv` movies with transparency) in the Android, iOS and web engines too
- kagex-release 0.18.0 downloads the 0.18.0 engines

The sample game with Live2D (`kagex_sample_live2d_<platform>`, added to this release once it's out) holds Live2D's Cubism Core: by installing or playing it you agree not to copy the Cubism Core out of it, distribute it apart from the game, modify it, or reverse engineer, decompile or disassemble it. It uses sample data owned and copyrighted by Live2D Inc.

Everything in this release is listed in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/krkren/kagex/blob/0.18.0/CHANGELOG.md).

On Windows the engine needs OpenGL ES: a graphics driver that supports it, or ANGLE's `libEGL.dll` and `libGLESv2.dll` next to `krkrz.exe`.

The macOS app and tools aren't signed with an Apple Developer ID, so macOS blocks them the first time: open the app from the context menu (Open), or allow it under System Settings > Privacy & Security; for the tools, `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine kagex-release kagex-lipsync`. The Android APK is signed with a debug key: allow installs from unknown sources, or use `adb install`. The sample's iOS build is for the Simulator; kagex-release signs a game for iPhones and iPads with your own Apple Developer certificate.
